title: Wendell and the Machine
author: Zephyrine Eastwick
blurb: Mara Fairweather, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
